summary: Region, city and district as three cascading selects. Presentational: the places come from a DgaGeoDataSource the app passes in ({ regions(), cities(regionId), districts(cityId) } returning a promise or observable); it never calls HTTP. A signal-model control of { regionId, cityId, districtId }.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The chosen ids; a new region clears city and district, a new city clears district; two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: touched
inputs.description: Becomes true when a level loses focus; two-way [(touched)].

inputs.name: dataSource
inputs.description: Where the places come from (static data or the app's API service).

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: The language of the place names.

inputs.name: depth
inputs.description: How many levels to show: region, plus city, plus district.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible group name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: The empty choice of every level (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated), shown on the first level still missing a choice.

inputs.name: loadErrorText
inputs.description: Shown on a level whose list failed to load (translated).

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new selection after every choice (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true when a level first loses focus.

outputs.name: loadFailed
outputs.description: The level whose list failed to load.

a11y: A fieldset (legend or aria-label) holding native dga-select controls, each with a visible label, so the browser supplies the keyboard model. The group is aria-busy while a list loads; a level is disabled until its parent is chosen. Errors are linked to their select by aria-describedby and set aria-invalid. The levels follow reading order and wrap, so RTL mirrors them.
